articleTitle: The comparison of forecasting analysis based on the ARIMA-LSTM hybrid models
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: For ARIMA-LSTM hybrid model, it can be mixed in different ways. Because ARIMA model can be separated into three parts: trend, seasonality, and residuals. One way is that using LSTM model to forecast residuals of ARIMA model, while another way is that using LSTM model to forecast seasonality and residuals of ARIMA model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE are used to measure the fit of two different ARIMA-LSTM hybrid models with the data of 2010–2020 Shenzhen maximum temperature every 3 hours. In result, it is concluded that using LSTM model to forecast residuals of ARIMA model is a better way to forecast than another

articleTitle: Research on the Application of BIM Technology in the Design of Green Buildings
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the increasingly serious environmental problems, the country pays more and more attention to the green and low-carbon development of the construction industry and vigorously promotes the development of green buildings. In recent years, the rise of BIM technology has gradually been promoted in the construction industry. This article describes the overview of BIM technology and the concept of green buildings, combined with the Daxing Airport case to illustrate that BIM technology plays a vital role in green buildings, and it is of great significance to promote the use of BIM in green buildings.

articleTitle: Supply chain resilience in the post-epidemic period: a case study on JD-VSP Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The outbreak of COVID-19 has disrupted people's pace of life and greatly affected the normal development of industry and commerce. Different types of enterprises have experienced different degrees of losses. The e-commerce companies, which rely on both labor and information techniques, have been influenced obviously. To investigate the resilience supply chains of e-commerce companies in the post-epidemic era, we choose Jingdong (JD) as an example and identify their performances during this specific period. According to our analysis, JD has shown its strong supply chain management and service ability in the post-epidemic period of resuming work and production. Moreover, the functions of the digital technology integration system of the JD Smart Purchasing Platform are also demonstrated. It provides integrated supply chain service and procurement project service that faces those relative enterprises. In conclusion, applying the Information Visualization management system could provide an efficient reference for supply chain management of e-commerce companies.

Author Keywords: specific supply chain under post-epidemic period

articleTitle: Research on the Problem of 3D Bin Packing under Incomplete Information Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The Bin Packing Problem (BPP) in the logistics industry is a classic NP-hard problem. In practical applications, often only the size information of the current box can be obtained whereas getting the information of the subsequent boxes almost impossible. In consequence, an algorithm is very important for giving the packing position in the case of incomplete information. This paper used Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithm and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), formed the state input shape for this problem to establish a model to solve the 3D bin packing problem under incomplete information. This model can achieve an average space utilization of 65%. The study's results proved that the model can solve the packing problem under incomplete information and has certain practical benefits.

articleTitle: Study on influencing Factors and Control measures of Asphalt Pavement Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: In view of the problem of asphalt pavement disease, the paper discusses the influencing factors of asphalt pavement quality in detail, and studies the influence of granular content and crushing value content of aggregate as well as the degree of gradation and segregation on the water stability of the mixture. The influence of weight and type of roller on road compaction was studied. This paper analyzes the intelligent control technology of asphalt pavement construction and puts forward the key points of control in the process of asphalt pavement construction. The results show that with the increase of crushing value and needle flake content, the residual stability and splitting strength ratio of the mixture decrease gradually, and the water stability becomes worse. With the increase of the quality of steel roller and rubber roller, the road compaction tends to increase. With the increase of aggregate segregation value, the residual stability and residual stability ratio of the mixture gradually decreased. Asphalt pavement construction intelligent control technology can realize pavement construction process control, real-time feedback, comprehensive monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Transformation to Empower Power Grid Enterprises' High-Quality Development Strategies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: In recent years, due to factors such as geopolitics, trade disputes, and the new crown epidemic, a new round of scientific and technological revolution has emerged, accelerating the extensive and deep integration of the digital economy. In 2020, the scale of China's digital economy will exceed 32 trillion yuan, accounting for 35% of GDP. my country's digital economy is shifting from incremental expansion to the 2.0 era of stock competition. 50% of China's top 1000 companies regard digital transformation as their strategic core, and digital transformation has become an inevitable trend in the future. Especially in the energy industry, with the rapid advancement of industrial reforms and the continuous deepening of power system reforms, many problems such as limited profitability and low efficiency faced by the development of power grid enterprises have become increasingly prominent. Grid companies have been deeply aware of the importance of digital transformation, and urgently need to accelerate internal reforms to improve the quality of enterprise development, and use digital transformation to transform into energy Internet companies. In view of this, this paper first analyzes the difficulties faced by the digital transformation of power grid enterprises, and then makes an in-depth discussion on the overall management strategies based on data, technology, business and platform for reference.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Bottlenecks in Automobile Industry – Based on the Database Method of the Whole Automobile Industry Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: After the outbreak of COVID-19 in 2020, the industrial supply chain in different industries has exposed a series of problems. The Party Central Committee clearly pointed out that we should improve the stability and competitiveness of the industrial supply chain. The upstream and downstream automobile industry has a long industry chain with a complex supply system, and it has both shortcomings and advantages. In order to ensure the stability of the supply chain of China's automobile industry, analyze the bottlenecks of the industry and put forward corresponding solutions, this paper used big data to establish a supply chain database of independent brand automobile as a new analysis tool, to enhance the analysis accuracy, specify the measures and analyze the key links of China's automobile industry being controlled by others through the network diagram and risk rating table. Next, it is suggested to establish and improve the supply chain database of the whole automobile industry as soon as possible, improve the data collection and inter departmental coordination mechanism, and accelerate the establishment of a “dual circulation” development pattern of a new system of automobile industry development in which domestic economic cycle plays a leading role while international economic cycle remains its extension and supplement.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Twin Technology in Intelligent Building Energy Efficiency Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Building energy utilization has always been the focus of attention from all walks of life. Taking the intelligent building energy efficiency management system as the research object, this paper discusses the application of digital twin technology in the system. This paper expounds the application scope and main functions of digital twin technology, and describes the application process. This paper identifies the types of energy consumption quotas for smart buildings and selects the sample size. The requirements of the energy efficiency management system are extracted through configuration strategies and plans, and energy consumption standards under the same load have been established. We have used the dual technology of digitally optimized equipment energy-saving modes. The case analysis results show that the energy-saving contribution rate after the transformation reaches 21.524%, exceeding the expected target of 1.524 %, which proves that the energy consumption is lower after the application of digital twin technology.

articleTitle: A study on spatial distribution characteristics of city hotels based on GIS method: a date analysis based on POI data of Zhejiang hotels
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: This paper deals with the data from 8,524 hotels POI data in Hangzhou by GIS spatial analysis method. Then, it analyzes the spatial layout characteristics and concentration of discreteness of Hangzhou hotels by using nearest neighbors, spatial nuclear density and other methods. It finds out that the analysis method based on network POI data can fully reflect the distribution of hotel space in Hangzhou area, and the distribution of the hotel space in Hangzhou and all districts shows agglomeration characteristics, and the hotel's high-density gathering area is formed in the central city and important functional areas, and the hotel development in the emerging areas is obviously insufficient.

articleTitle: Application of Assembly Project Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Relying on the assembly project - dormitory of BBMG, BIM is applied in the whole process of design, production and construction. It is found that BIM is mature in the design phase, and the software function of collision check and pipeline integration can find problems in advance, so as to reduce engineering changes. But BIM is insufficient in the production stage and construction stage. In the production stage, the information management system can issue commands to MES, but can not receive the feedback information from MES; Due to the low degree of standardization of prefabricated components, reinforcement around, poor accuracy and low adaptability of automation equipment, the degree of automation and informatization of the PC factory is low; In the construction stage, BIM software and equipment should be enriched to realize digital chemical land.

articleTitle: Research on the promotion path of scientific and technological innovation ability of marine industry based on big data under the background of marine power strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China proposed the strategic goal of “maritime power”, China's economy has developed into an export-oriented economy highly dependent on the ocean and rich in marine resources., and the digital innovation of marine industry science and technology has become an important growth point to promote economic development. Based on the background of China's in-depth implementation of the strategy of strengthening the marine power., this paper studies and judges the development trend of scientific and technological innovation in the domestic marine field, and focuses on the analysis of the current situation of marine scientific and technological innovation in China's coastal economy and the existing problems such as the lack of power to develop marine information technology innovation relying on big data cloud computing and other technologies., This paper discusses the basic principles of marine science and technology progress and the countermeasures to promote marine science and technology innovation. Finally., the paper comes to the conclusion that we should adhere to the domestic circular development mode of cultivating the ability of independent innovation., supplemented by attracting foreign investment., so as to promote the development of China's Marine Science and technology innovation in the direction of digitization., service and modernization., and provide new ideas for the construction of marine power.

articleTitle: Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to analyze the tropical cyclone risk index of 15 coastal cities in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Tropical cyclone is a common natural disaster, which causes detriment along its routine. In this paper, using the analytic hierarchy process (ahp) to conduct the risk assessment of tropical cyclones in the 15 coastal cities in China and analysis. Selecting 15 cities along the coast of China as the research object, the tropical cyclone disaster risk, the vulnerability of hazard-affected body, disaster prevention and mitigation capacity in preliminary evaluation. The evaluation index and 19 poor value are selected to standardize data processing, and then the weighted comprehensive evaluation method was used to obtain each evaluation index. On this basis, the comprehensive risk assessment system of tropical cyclone disaster was established, and the risk distribution of tropical cyclone in coastal areas of China was obtained. The results showed that: (1) Yangjiang, Haikou, Xiamen and other cities were seriously affected by tropical cyclones, and they were also high risk areas, so the early warning of tropical cyclones should be improved in this area; (2) The high value areas of vulnerability of disaster bearing bodies are mainly distributed in Shanghai, Xiamen, Guangzhou and other cities; (3) Shantou, Yangjiang, Wenzhou and other cities are relatively weak in disaster prevention and mitigation capacity, these areas should strengthen investment in infrastructure and medical and health care. In general, the tropical cyclone risk index in the south coast of China is generally higher than that in the north coast.

articleTitle: Research on dual-model recycling Pricing of waste household appliances based on Stackelberg game
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the improvement of our country's economic level, the speed of replacement of waste household electrical appliances has accelerated, and the issue of recycling and pricing of waste household electrical appliances has always been a concern of society and enterprises. This research focuses on the pricing of the recycler household appliances under the dual-modes of manufacturer's self-recycling and individual recyclers' recycling. Using the idea of game theory, a manufacturer-led Stackelberg game pricing model is constructed, and the pricing model of single-mode recycling and dual-mode recycling of household appliances is compared and analyzed. The results show that dual-mode recycling can effectively improve the economic profit and recycling efficiency of enterprises, which is more scientific for enterprises.

articleTitle: Study on the influence factor analysis and cost control optimization of distribution network project cost
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Aiming at the demand for lean improvement in cost control of distribution network engineering, this paper uses Grey Relation Analysis Method to conduct a comprehensive and systematic analysis of the impact mechanism of distribution network engineering cost, and ranks the importance of the cost influencing factors. In the end, the factors with a large degree of influence are selected as the key points to control the project cost, and the optimization strategy for the management and control of the distribution network project cost of 10kV and below is proposed, so as to implement the results of standardization construction into the entire process of the construction and transformation of the distribution network, and solve the problem of standardization management.

articleTitle: Research on Prevention and Control Strategies for the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympic Games Under the Impact of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has brought severe challenges and great uncertainties to the preparations and normal staging of the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics. Based on this background, this paper analyzes the global COVID-19 for the future development of three kinds of epidemic situation, different situation the different influence to the Beijing Olympics, and finally from the games competitions held offline and use the Internet online hold the perspective of two run competitions modes, respectively, under the influence of the global COVID-19 outbreak proposed the concrete prevention and control countermeasures of the Beijing Olympics. In order to provide theoretical reference and decision-making support for the normal holding and operation of Beijing Winter Olympic Games.

articleTitle: Analysis of Hate Crime Rates in the United States: Statistical Modeling of Public Safety Issues Based on Socioeconomic Factors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a surge in awareness on hate crimes, in the United States of America and globally. News outlets have been publishing increasingly more coverages on distressing incidents of hate crimes across the country. More attention is needed to decipher the sources influencing the rise in hate crimes. This paper seeks to explore the relationship between United States hate crime rates and several socioeconomic factors. The data used throughout the study contains hate crimes rates, as well as information on varying factors including income, unemployment, race and citizenship distribution, urbanization and education attainment by state, for the year 2019. Four models are built for variable selection and model performance is compared to derive the best model to explain the factors influencing hate crime rate. The multiple linear regression, lasso regression, ridge regression and elastic net regressions all provide evidence to support the proposal that median household income, income inequality, and unemployment rates are significant factors in determining the appearance of hate crimes. The best-performing ridge regression model also implies the proportion of white people living in poverty is associated with hate crimes, but other models with similar performance do not have sufficient evidence to support this. Separating the states by their political inclination shows that the proportion of white people and the share of white people living in poverty have positive influences on hate crime rates in Republican states, whereas in Democratic states, median household income and unemployment rates are the two most significant factors influencing hate crime. However, further research is needed to establish relationships between hate crime rate and factors such as race and residency status for the United States as a whole.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Explore the research fronts of sustainable supply chain management in the context of big data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: As we enter the 21st century, the world's industrialization is gradually aligning itself with big data and is greatly benefiting from the information benefits it brings. Regardless of the region, the access to supply chain information by big data is more efficient than that of the non-big data era. Big data adds value in the management of supply chain information and provides a new guarantee for supply chain sustainability. In this context, to systematically review the relevant literature in this field, this study used the WOS database to analyze the development of the research fronts of sustainable supply chain management in the context of big data, based on a scientometric analysis of 109 articles published from 2015 to 2021 collected in the WoS database, summarising the year of publication, author's research direction, publication institution since 2015, and publications, and analyses the authors' keywords with a visual synthesis of their presentations. This paper aims to provide some references for researchers, managers, and industry professionals.

articleTitle: The Impact of Digital Technology on the Employment Demand of Electric Power Enterprises: Taking State Grid Corporation of China as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Digital technologies such as big data, cloud computing, block chain, and 5G are increasingly widely used in electric power enterprises. With the application of digital technology, the demand for employees has also changed accordingly. The purpose of this research is to analyze the impact of digital technology on the employment demand of electric power enterprise. The results of the study show that the trend and degree of influence of digital technology on different positions are different. The employment strategy of electric power enterprises should shift from “talents for me” to “talents for my use”.

articleTitle: Analysis and Forecast of Energy Electrification Level in Jilin Province of China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Electrification is an important symbol of the progress of modern civilization. Electrification interacts with economic and social development, showing a positive correlation. The widespread application of electric power has promoted the continuous improvement of industrial and agricultural production efficiency and social productivity, and economic and social development has promoted the increase of the proportion of electric power in the final energy consumption. The paper uses official statistical data to calculate the level of energy electrification in Jilin Province over the years. At the same time, the energy consumption and power consumption of Jilin Province under the three scenarios are predicted, and then the energy electrification level of Jilin Province for a period of time in the future is predicted through the calculation method of energy electrification.

articleTitle: Research on engineering Technology application of a company based on Ansys Workbench software
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Taking J Company's wooden pallet packaging as an example, at the present stage, wooden pallet packaging has serious failure problems, increased costs, insufficient reuse, and the company's own issue solving effect is not significant. Collect information on enterprise issue through on-site survey, find problems through video analysis, and determine key problem factors combined with brainstorming; Ansys Workbench software was used to carry out finite element analysis of the main problem factors, and based on the calculation results of Ansys Workbench, it proposed to standardize forklift operation and reduce the types of wooden pallets, so that J Company could achieve the purpose of reducing the cost of wooden pallets. The organic combination of IE thinking and Ansys Workbench analysis technology enables enterprises to find and solve problems in practical engineering application.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization scheduling of micro-grid with energy storage under time-of-use price mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: During the operation of the microgrid, the output power of some distributed power sources is fluctuating and intermittent, which will bring huge challenges to the planning and operation of the microgrid. In view of the high penetration rate of renewable energy connected to the microgrid, combined with the effect of the energy storage device in the microgrid on peak shaving and valley filling of the grid according to the changes in user demand at different times and the difference in electricity prices, this paper formulates energy dispatch under dynamic market pricing. The goal is to minimize economic costs and minimize environmental pollution during system operation. By adjusting the switch state of the controllable unit, the charge and discharge state of the energy storage battery, and the interaction between the microgrid and the large grid, when formulate the best control sequence of each unit in every cycle. The improved fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) is used to find the Pareto optimal solutions for the four scenarios. Through the analysis of the energy scheduling strategy and the non-adopted scheduling strategy, the results show that the proposed scheduling strategy can effectively reduce the economic cost and optimize the environmental benefits, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Renewable Energy Power Consumption Certificate Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With China's steady progress in the development and construction of renewable energy, the proportion of renewable energy in China is increasing, and the willingness of market players to purchase renewable energy power is increasing. However, the existing technical means have single tracking indicators, low reliability, difficult supervision, and can not track the consumption of users safely, transparently and efficiently. The paper introduces blockchain technology into renewable energy consumption voucher transaction. Firstly, it introduces the problems faced by renewable energy power consumption vouchers; Secondly, it studies the key technologies of blockchain to meet the power consumption demand of renewable energy; Finally, a renewable energy power consumption voucher management method based on blockchain technology is designed.

articleTitle: Design of Human Resource Salary Management System for State-owned Enterprises Based on SSH Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Due to the problems of data loss, poor data import capability and low resource utilization in traditional systems, a state-owned enterprise human resources salary management system based on SSH architecture was designed for this purpose. Based on the SSH architecture, the overall system architecture and login management, user management and salary management sub-function modules are designed. This paper designs the salary data import algorithm to ensure the validity and safety of the salary data, and completes the design of the state-owned enterprise human resources salary management system. The experimental results show that the system has a low data loss rate, a good data import capability, and a high resource utilization rate.

articleTitle: Application of Natural Language Processing Model in Agricultural Index System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the development of China's agricultural economy, the study of agricultural development theory has also made remarkable achievements, but the study of agricultural index system is still in the primary stage. In this paper, the evaluation index system of Chinese scholars in various agricultural development directions is collected through HowNet and VIP database, and the unique index system of each agricultural development direction is obtained by using text feature extraction model, and an index dictionary is established. At the same time, the accuracy of the unique index system corresponding to each agricultural development direction is verified by using the text classification model. The results show that the index system generated by the model can well represent different agricultural development directions, and has important reference significance for the establishment and weighting of agricultural index system.

articleTitle: Study on intelligent response of emergency logistics under magnitude outburst public health events based on new generation information technology intelligent facilities and equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The concept of intelligent development of the logistics industry has been put forward to promote the deep integration of new generation information technology such as big data, block chain, 5G, artificial intelligence and its intelligent facilities and equipment with logistics activities. While in recent years, the outbreak of the COVID-19 has not only attracted worldwide attention, but also posed a challenge to the emergency logistics guarantee system throughout China in the process of epidemic prevention and control. In this paper, based on the existing research, the mechanism of material circulation under emergency is explored and improved based on blockchain with cryptography and smart contract technologies. After innovation and optimization, the mechanism makes it possible to improve the technology of emergency logistics and the level of deep application of wisdom, providing reasonable suggestions and improvement measures for the future management system.

articleTitle: Analysis on Competitiveness of Port Logistics along the Yangtze River in Jiangsu
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the status quo of port logistics development along the Yangtze River in Jiangsu, this paper constructs a port logistics competitiveness evaluation indicator system from four dimensions: port infrastructure, scale of port logistics, urban economic level, and potential for port development. The entropy weight TOPSIS method is used to compare and analyze the logistics competitiveness of the eight ports along the Yangtze River in Jiangsu. Finally, it proposes relevant suggestions to improve the comprehensive logistics competitiveness of ports along the Yangtze River, including establishing port groups, improving port logistics infrastructure, and accelerating multimodal transportation.

articleTitle: Construction of investment measurement model adapted to the typical scheme of power 5G fusion network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the construction of a new power system under the national “dual carbon” goal, the power 5G integrated network is proposed to promote the upgrading to the energy Internet, and provide the network information service to meet the needs of energy production and consumption revolution. However, the cost of carrying out the fusion network is a high concern of all sectors of society, so it is necessary to construct an investment measurement model covering the characteristics of network construction, cost composition and market factor price change trend. The paper analyzes factors influencing the investment of power 5G fusion network. Based on the different fusion network schemes, the cost constructions are built. Finally, the costs are measured based on the cost equation. The results indicate the scheme of using carrier bearer network below the core of prefecture and city is the better choice due to the lower cost.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Port Logistics in Pearl River Delta from the Perspective of Supply Chain Based on Super-Efficiency Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The improvement of port logistics performance plays an important role in promoting regional economic development. From the perspective of the supply chain, this paper uses a combination of Super-Efficiency Data Envelopment Analysis (SE-DEA) and Interval Analytic Hierarchy Process (IAHP) to evaluate the logistics operation performance of seven major port companies in the Pearl River Delta. It can provide a scientific basis for the Chinese government to formulate plans, and it also provides theoretical support for the port to effectively integrate resources, cultivate new development momentum, and enhance competitiveness.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of electricity market considering time delay factors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Considering that the demand side of the electricity market has a lag in obtaining price information, a dynamic trading model of the electricity market based on linear time-varying delay system is proposed. According to the Lyapunov stability analysis theory, the Lyapunov functional is constructed, and the sufficient conditions for the stability of the model are analyzed and given. This method applies the theory of stability of time-delay system to the study of dynamic trading stability of electricity market. By comparing the coefficients in equation, the stability of dynamic trading of electricity market with time-delay is discussed in the sense of Lyapunov. Then, a set of numerical examples are given to verify that the system is stable under the above sufficient conditions.

Author Keywords: time varying linear delay differential equations

articleTitle: Seller's Pricing Discrimination Strategies under Adoption of Online Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of big data technology, a seller can identify its targeted customers precisely and comprehensively. Therefore, the seller can take pricing discrimination strategies when facing heterogeneous customers. This paper uses a two-stage game model to learn and compare the seller's three types of pricing strategies: no discrimination, two-part discriminatory pricing, and personalized discriminatory pricing. We found that sellers' profit adopting a discriminatory pricing strategy is higher than that of a traditional single pricing strategy. At the same time, for the comparison of the two discriminatory pricing strategies, customers find that the company is more likely to adopt a discriminatory pricing strategy. The cost of strategy and data input is low, and the company adopts a personalized and more favorable price discrimination strategy. Otherwise, it adopts a double price discrimination pricing strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Vegetable Ordering Strategy Considering Quantity Discount Based on a Multiproduct Nonlinear Programming Model and the Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Formulating scientific ordering strategies to increase profits has always been a common concern of merchants and scholars. This paper takes Y supermarket as an example and establishes a multi-product nonlinear programming model with resource constraints. The model comprehensively considers the influence of uncertain demand, the quantity discount and the attrition rate on the order quantity. Then, it is programmed by the Genetic Algorithm method. At last, this research analyzes the results with specific cases and compares the results with other models. The results show that the model is of high interpretability and operability, which can make the ordering strategy of supermarkets more scientific.

articleTitle: Research on the Talent Training Mode of Integrated Development of Logistics and Tourism under the background of “New Business”
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: According the “Outline of the National Program for Medium - and Long-Term Education Reform and Development (2010-2020)”, it is pointed out that cultivating a large number of high-quality talents with innovative spirit and practical ability is a major goal of China's education reform and development in the next 10 years. Under the background of actively promoting the construction of new business, this paper discusses the deficiencies, new ideas, new models and new methods of talent training for the integrated development of logistics and Tourism under the background of new business, and emphasizes on “innovation ability, social and communication ability, providing comprehensive interdisciplinary education for students.

articleTitle: Exploration of rural e-commerce boosting rural revitalization based on big data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: In the era of big data, the digital economy represented by e-commerce can revitalize the existing resources in rural areas, stimulate the vitality of “agriculture, rural areas and farmers”, accelerate the modernization of agricultural and rural areas, and promote the implementation of the national strategy for rural revitalization. This article aims to explain the current development of my country's rural e-commerce, analyze the power mechanism of e-commerce to promote rural revitalization from multiple dimensions, and give targeted exploration paths to promote rural revitalization.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Innovation Ability on the Radiation and Leading Role of Regional Central City: Take the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban agglomeration as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: By constructing an innovation capability evaluation index system, we comprehensively measure the innovation capabilities of cities in Beijing- Tianjin-Hebei Urban Agglomeration. Based on the gravity model, breakpoint model and field intensity model, we analyze the impact of innovation capability on the radiation effect of the central city. The main conclusions are as follows: firstly, it is found that the innovation ability of each city in the urban agglomeration has been enhanced, and the regional collaborative innovation has been enhanced significantly. Secondly, the innovation radiation of Beijing has been promoted gradually, and the radiation scope has been strengthened continuously. The innovation ability has obvious positive promotion function to the radiation effect of Beijing.

articleTitle: Default Electricity Pricing Model for Operational Users Based on Maximizing Social Welfare
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: From the perspective of social welfare, this article constructs an optimization model for the default electricity price of operational users based on maximizing social welfare, considering the power and price levels on the user side and the power generation side. The constraints such as power generation and consumption balance, pollutant emissions, renewable energy consumption, electricity marketization process, and cross-subsidy are comprehensively incorporated. By solving the proposed model using the actual data of a certain province, the default electricity price levels of users of different voltage levels during peak, flat, and valley periods are obtained, showing that the default electricity price level of operational users which maximizes social welfare is significantly reduced to a certain extent compared with the electricity price level of the current sales catalogue.

articleTitle: Research on resource-constrained multi-project scheduling problem considering resource substitution based on ant colony optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Facing the R&D process of group enterprises, the substitutability of renewable resources is introduced into the resource-constrained multi-project scheduling problem, and a resource-constrained multi-project scheduling problem model considering the substitutability of resources is established. Ant colony optimization (ACO) is used to solve the model. By using the series schedule generation scheme (SSGS) and conflict resolution strategy, the efficiency of ACO is improved. The network example shows that the mathematical optimization model considering resource substitutability is closer to the actual management process of enterprise R&D projects, and the model can effectively shorten the total construction period of multi-projects and improve the efficiency of resource utilization.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Simulation Technology in Automotive Professional Culture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, virtual simulation technology and began to participate in the automobile field, virtual simulation technology has attracted wide attention and favor. In recent years, virtual simulation technology and began to engage in the automotive field. This paper mainly discusses how good virtual simulation technology in the automobile industry.

articleTitle: Research on the risk of the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympic Games and the countermeasures of the preparatory work transition under the influence of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: As the most influential sports event in the world, there will be many athletes and spectators from all over the world during the Olympic Games. However, the continuing severe global COVID-19 situation has a significant impact on the smooth hosting of the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics Games (hereinafter referred to as the “Beijing Winter Olympics”). Based on above, this paper analyzed the impact of the global COVID-19 and expounded the six risks of Beijing Winter Olympic Games. Finally, it provided corresponding suggestions and countermeasures of the preparatory work transition for the change of running mode. It is expected to provide theoretical reference and decision-making support for the Beijing Winter Olympic Games to prevent and control of the COVID-19 emergency risk.

articleTitle: Research on Finite Element Analysis of Condensation Process of Mass Concrete Based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The heat of hydration released in the curing process of mass concrete will produce large temperature changes and shrinkage, and the resulting temperature and shrinkage stress are the main factors that lead to cracks in concrete. Taking the mass concrete of an abutment as the research object, using ANSYS finite element analysis software, according to the actual situation of concrete pouring construction, this paper discretizes the abutment into solid70 three-dimensional solid element, and then applies boundary conditions and temperature load to simulate the unstable temperature field and the resulting stress field in the concrete structure. The temperature and stress values of some nodes are analyzed to provide a theoretical basis for crack prevention measures and crack remediation methods in the actual construction process.

articleTitle: Project Management Promotion of Huangmaohai Link based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Building Information Modelling (BIM) technology has attracted widespread attention from global governments, scholars and engineers. This paper introduces the application of BIM technology, including information transfer, project collaboration management, digital construction, and data analysis and visualization, in a mega cross-see infrastructure project, the Huangmaohai Link. Through application of BIM technology, Huangmaohai Link achieves the goal of high-quality construction and refined management.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Management of Nike
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: For a company, supply chain management (SCM) has been playing an increasingly important role. Therefore, how to improve the SCM of an enterprise will be a key issue. This paper focuses on solving Nike's SCM problems in stock, which can be divided into stock shortage and overstock. Nike's inventory is highly volatile, leading to errors in both parts, especially during Corona Virus Disease (COVID-19). The sharp drop in offline store sales and logistics closures have made its overstock a bigger problem than the shortage. And its obsolete inventory and seasonal stock are the biggest causes of the excess. By drawing on the cases of Zara and Dell, this paper suggests that Nike should integrate big data analysis, cloud computing and many other technologies to enhance its demand forecast. Also, it can establish the electronic data interchange (EDI) system, as well as the vendor managed inventory (VMI) warehouses to reduce unnecessary production costs and improve its operation efficiency. Besides, Nike can imitate the Taobao evaluation mechanism and adopt marketing strategies to expand advantages of the e-commerce.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain management problems and the solutions existing in 7-11 convenience stores based on the intelligent algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the development of the times, people realize that the competition of modern business is not only the competition among individual enterprises, but also the competition between supply chains. Therefore, there is an increasing number of academic and industry studies of the supply chain management which are becoming more and more in-depth. Owing to the fact that the convenience store industry pays special attention to turnover and inventory control, supply chain management is a very important management content in the convenience store industry. At the same time, the supply chain management of 711 convenience stores in China is analyzed by a case study, an interview investigation and so on. Finally, some solutions to the above problems are given, such as the utilization of the intelligent algorithm, unattended stores, agent cooperation and creating special convenience store. For 711 convenience stores, these solutions can not only improve supply chain management, but also help them reduce costs, increase profits and break through the difficulties brought by new retailing. At the same time, it can also provide a certain reference for the whole convenience store industry.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Modeling of Internal Control Performance In State-owned Cultural Enterprises Under the Context of Digital Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Deepening the reform of public service system and accelerating the promotion of digital management in state-owned cultural enterprises are very important for enabling the innovation and development of cultural enterprises. Based on the theories of efficiency theory, agency theory, signal transmission theory and incomplete contract theory, two relevant hypotheses and empirical models are constructed. Correlation analysis and empirical analysis are used to verify the relationship between ownership concentration and ownership nature on the effectiveness of internal control. The empirical results show that the ownership concentration is positively correlated with the effectiveness of internal control, that is, the higher the ownership concentration, the better the internal control. The moderate concentration of equity can achieve the purpose of achieving the consistency of the interests of major shareholders and the company, also improve the enthusiasm of major shareholders. But the nature of equity has no significant impact on the effectiveness of internal control.

articleTitle: The Impact of the Application of Digital Technology on Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Digital technology has a profound impact on corporate management methods which require adaptive adjustments. The purpose of this research is to study how enterprise human resource management should adapt to the development of digital technology. The results of this research show that digital technology has affected job setting, labor demand and talent structure of enterprises. Human resource management needs to change from management and control to empowerment.

articleTitle: New Product Development Process Models
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: New product development process significantly influences performance of product design and development system. Many researchers and practitioners established different new product development process models based on various knowledge background and practical experiences. While, there is lack of literature to comprehensively analyze and discuss distinct new product development processes. This research studied different new product development processes and their typical features from engineering design perspectives. This paper presented various models of new product development process, analyzed impacting factors to the performance of product development systems, commented both advantages and shortcomings in the real world operation environment. Results from this research would be beneficial to those researchers, practitioner and managerial personnel in engineering enterprises.

articleTitle: Default Electricity Pricing Model for Operational Users Considering the Cross-subsidy under the “Dual Track System”
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: When Chinese power grid companies undertake guaranteed power supply services, they must also comprehensively consider the issue of cross-subsidy on the power generation side under the “dual track system”. This paper analysed the foreign experience of guaranteed power supply, and then design a default electricity price model for operational users, which includes four components named energy costs, cross-subsidies, network transmission costs (transmission and distribution costs), and government fund surcharges. The results show that: (1) The nature of guaranteed power supply in various countries is the institutional guarantee for the reliability of consumer electricity, not a social welfare; (2) Guaranteed power supply service providers usually include power producers and power retailers. Transmission and distribution network companies usually do not participate in guaranteed power supply services; (3) Considering that China has a dual-track system, it is necessary to introduce cross-subsidies in the pricing of guaranteed power supply services.

articleTitle: The Influence of High-speed Railway on the Factor Resources Flow in the Yangtze River Delta Urban Agglomeration Based on Experimental and Mathematical Statistics Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: High-speed railway is exerting a profound influence on China's economic development. However, among the more and more research results on the economic effect of highspeed railway, there is still a lack of research on the impact of high-speed rail on the factor resources flow from the perspective of urban agglomeration. So this paper conducted an empirical study based on panel data from 2008 to 2019 on 26 cities in the Yangtze River Delta Urban Agglomeration, calculated the labor flow index and the capital flow index as the dependent variables, and the interaction item of whether high-speed railway has opened or not was taken as dummy variable, and 6 control variables are introduced into the multi-period DID model. And the parallel trend test is also carried out. The empirical results represent that the opening of high-speed railway has no significant impact on labor flow, but high-speed railway can significantly promote the capital flow in the Yangtze River Delta, and this impact will gradually increase as time goes by. In addition, testing results of different samples show that high-speed railway has a more significant effect on capital flow in megacities than in large and medium-sized cities. According to the model results, some suggestions are put forward from the perspective of promoting the coordinated development of the Yangtze River Delta area.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Government Affairs Center Service System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Service system optimization is an important part of the current government affairs center construction and development. Its purpose is to better serve the broad masses of people in handling various affairs, improve service quality, coordinate departmental cooperation, and improve work efficiency. Through on-site investigations to the government affairs center, it was found that there are differences in the number and speed of business processing between different departments. The real estate business is compared with the passport business processing window, the real estate business phenomenon and work logic description and the passport business process requirements and improved design are analyzed in detail, and the cooperation between coordination and mutual work is considered and explored. The final conclusion will be areas where government services citizens demand characteristics and the government center service system queues expand research design, optimization design services to complete the government center, government center study designed to explore in depth the system.

articleTitle: Establishment of risk early warning index system for PPP projects in characteristic towns
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Characteristic towns have been widely promoted as a powerful carrier to promote the integration of urban and rural development and implement the strategy of rural revitalization. In order to solve the financing problem of the characteristic town, the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) mode is introduced. However, based on the emerging characteristics of characteristic towns and the lack of experience in risk management combined with the PPP mode, there is an urgent need for the identification and early warning of risk factors throughout the process of PPP projects in characteristic towns. This research uses literature analysis and case analysis, as well as expert interviews, to obtain the final list of risk factors for PPP projects in characteristic towns, including 5 risk types and 30 risk factors. On this basis, the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) was used to identify 21 key risk factors for PPP projects in characteristic towns, and a risk warning index system for the whole life cycle of characteristic towns PPP projects was constructed.

articleTitle: Research on Fresh Supply Chain Optimization Decision-Making Considering Blockchain and Freshness-keeping Effort
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: A two-echelon supply chain consisting of a fresh food supplier and an e-commerce was studied in this paper. By constructing a centralized and decentralized decision model, the influence of transparency elasticity of demand, freshness elasticity of demand was analyzed, whose effectiveness on the optimal decision by considering the influence of transparency and freshness on consumer demand were studied. A “cost-sharing-profit-sharing” contract was designed for supply chain optimization and coordination, and the result of profit function optimization based on cost and benefit was obtained by employing the multi-objective optimization. The result showed that the increase of product demand elasticity is beneficial to both suppliers and e-merchants, and the impact of transparency demand elasticity on profit level is more sensitive. Both parties optimize toward the direction of validity improvement, and the adjustment of coordination parameters was applied to achieve a reasonable distribution of profits for both parties within the Pareto frontier solution.

articleTitle: Study on Ordering Strategy of Automobile Manufacturer considering Interruption Risk and Random Supply Risk Based on the Paperboy Model and the Matlab Software
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The core enterprises in the automobile industry are automobile manufacturers. Due to the increasing competition in the industry, auto parts enterprises allow manufacturers to extend the payment policy to seize the market. However, it should be noted that the longer the credit period, it is easy to cause the short board effect of supply chain and even the reverse bullwhip effect of order shrinkage, that is, the supplier's delivery quantity is less than the manufacturer's order quantity. At the same time, the supplier has a certain probability of interruption risk due to the uncontrollability of various situations. Therefore, for automobile manufacturers, many problems need to be considered and analyzed to make a scientific ordering decision. In this paper, firstly, the paperboy model is used to establish the automobile manufacturer's order decision model considering the interruption risk and credit period, and then the Matlab software is used to simulate the order decision model, the sensitivity analysis of the model parameters is carried out.

articleTitle: Research on development countermeasures of new energy automobile industry based on hawk-dove game
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the entry of foreign automobile enterprises into China's new energy vehicle market, the competition pattern of the new energy vehicle industry has changed. Based on this, the hawk-dove game model including “foreign-local auto enterprises” is constructed, the strategies of each subject are analysed, and the conditions of system stability are discussed to achieve the balance of the system. The results show that the competitor's income and input cost are the important factors affecting the competition and cooperation behaviours of automobile enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Management Responsibility Assignment of General Contracting Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: General contracting mode has been increasingly willing to adopt to construction project. Safety management has become a key factor in the successful completion of the general contracting construction project. At present, there is a lack of safety management responsibilities for all parties involved in such projects. This study adopts the General Responsibility Assignment Software Patterns (GRASP) method to assign a new assignment of project safety management responsibilities. Three main management elements, including 19 main safety management responsibilities, are assigned to the owner, general contractor, builder, and supervisor. The results show that the general contractor has the primary responsibility to control risk of the entire project. The responsibility of the builder in safety management is mainly to perform specific tasks. Owners and supervisors are mainly responsible for meeting part of the legal requirements. The conclusion implies that a reasonable assignment of safety management responsibilities helps to operate the project safety management system more efficiently and reduce the accident rate.

articleTitle: Research on grid investment optimization model and implementation strategy based on the integration of traditional and emerging business
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the power system, a grid project investment optimization model and implementation strategy are established. The initial screening of grid investment projects for traditional and emerging business applications is carried out separately, and the reserve projects for grid investment are determined by using the index maximum method. The project optimization results of ideal experts are identified by applying the advantage of expert group decision making to achieve the optimal ranking of projects at the technical level. The capital constraints are introduced by combining modern portfolio theory to obtain combined with modern portfolio theory, the optimal combination of power grid investment projects is obtained by introducing capital constraints.

articleTitle: Modeling and Evaluating the Efficiency of DC UHV Trans Regional Transmission Scheme Considering Ancillary Services Cost
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Long distance electric energy transmission through DC UHV is a necessary condition for the large-scale development and transmission of clean energy. Based on the existing research, this paper further systematizes and perfects the method of modeling and evaluating the economic effectiveness of DC UHV. In the method proposed in this paper, the generator output characteristics, kWh cost, transmission wire cost, transmission loss and anciliary service price of receiving province are considered. In this paper, a case study is carried out with new methods and actual engineering data, and the sensitivity of the case study is analyzed.

articleTitle: Information Management System of Miners' Unsafe Behavior Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: In the field of coal mine safety management, the management of unsafe behaviors of miners is the top priority. In this paper, combining big data technology and the actual production situation of coal mines, we propose a 3D structure of the information management system for unsafe behavior of miners;and take the unsafe behavior records of miners accumulated by Shenhua Shendong Coal Group as an example, extract key information through central analysis to help managers make better decisions. Research shows that information management based on big data is a development trend in the field of coal mine behavior safety, and this method provides strong theoretical support for the information management of unsafe behavior of miners.

articleTitle: Forecasting China's Express Delivery based on R using ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: In recent years, the express industry has developed rapidly, and the express volume continues to set a new record. Since 2016, China's express volume has ranked first in the world. Facing the rapid growth of China's express industry, this paper used R software to analyze the monthly data of our country's express delivery business volume from 2010 to 2019 through the method of time series analysis, and made use of the automatic order setting function in the R language to construct an ARIMA forecasting model. Finally, the (0, 1, 2) *(2,1,0) [12] model was built. This model was used to predict the total express business in China in the next two years. The prediction results showed that the express volume in China would reach 83.2 billion and 100 billion in 2020 and 2021 respectively, which provide guidance for the better development of China's express industry in the future.

articleTitle: Strategic Research on the Value Remodeling of Power Grid Over-Aged Assets-Takes the Overhead Power Transmission Line Transformation of H Power Supply Company as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the continuous evolution of power system reform and safety production management, power grid companies are facing multiple challenges of ensuring safety and fine investment, reducing electricity price and increasing efficiency, and strengthening strong supervision and promoting development. First, the supervision of power transmission and distribution costs is becoming more and more strict, so the power grid companies are facing great pressure. According to the requirements of the cost supervision and examination policy of the power transmission and distribution price, it is required to reduce the over-aged assets when verifying the scale of the effective assets of the enterprise's recoverable income. Meanwhile, the operation and maintenance costs of over-aged assets will not be fully recovered through the power transmission and distribution price. Second, the scale of over-aged assets of power grid companies is increasing year by year. Long high-intensity and large-scale power grid construction brings a significant increase in asset scale, the existing technical renovation capital investment is difficult to adapt to the aging speed of assets, will bring further increase the risk of assets. Third, the requirements of safety production and equipment quality and efficiency are higher and higher. In order to adapt to the new situation of power transmission and distribution price reform and the strong supervision requirements of the government actively, reshape the value of over-aged assets, and strive for a reasonable pricing level, the power grid can transform over-aged assets through local technical transformation, transform over-aged assets into effective assets, extend the depreciation life of assets, and strive for a reasonable power transmission and distribution price.

articleTitle: Configuration Effect: Innovation Performance Evaluation and Modeling of Cooperatives
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The essence of economic development is innovation, and an important source of innovation is the new configuration of multiple factors. Cooperative economic is such a typical model worthy of research. Under socialism with Chinese characteristics, Cooperatives' innovation is a key measure in rural governance. The author, therefore, examines 51 forestry cooperatives that have been modeled by the Forestry Department of the Chinese Government. By using the tools of qualitative comparative analysis, the author discusses how some factors lead to the difference of cooperative's innovation performance from the aspects of subject composition, operation mechanism and business characteristics. The research has confirmed three conclusions. Firstly, long-term planning is a core requirement for cooperatives to produce high innovation performance. Secondly, four combination mechanisms enable cooperatives to produce high innovation performance. Thirdly, the combination of factors between the mechanisms that produce different innovation performances is asymmetrical. Around these possible combination mechanisms, the research concludes with recommendations to improve cooperatives' innovation performance. All in all, the research attempts to demonstrate the widespread existence of Schumpeter-style economic growth in Chinese cooperatives. And it provides a partial basis for the future formulation of China's rural policies.

articleTitle: Optimization of Collecting and Distributing Network of Xiamen Port Considering the Coordinated Development of Railway and Road
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Many problems of the inland distribution network of Xiamen Port have occured in recent years. To solve the problems of collecting and distributing network of Xiamen Port that the proportion of road transportation and railway transportation is not coordinated and too many carbon emissions is put into the air, this study finds the relevant data from the official website of Xiamen Statistics Bureau and relevant researches and build a linear programming model aiming at minimizing the total cost of the collecting and distributing network of Xiamen Port based on considering carbon emissions and time window. In this study, The decision variable of the linear programming model is the freight volume of each transportation route. To solve the model, genetic algorithm is used in this study, and the result of the model will be worked out with the genetic algorithm toolbox of the MATLAB software. Finally, the sensitivity analysis is carried out by increasing the rail capacity according to the result of the model and the reality of Xiamen Port. Through the analysis of the results, after considering about the cost of carbon emissions and increasing the rail capacity, the proportion of railway transportation will be improved.

articleTitle: A new supervision model of environmental accounting information disclosure based on machine learning theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the frequent occurrence of environmental problems, the state has introduced a series of policies and measures to strengthen the supervision of listed companies, but at the same time, there is also a “marginal ball” phenomenon: for example, enterprises disclose environmental accounting information data is incomplete, in an attempt to escape government control. With machine learning theory to assist government regulation, the level of environmental accounting information disclosure can be improved to a greater extent, and a new regulatory model of “government +” can be formed.

articleTitle: Can Corporate Weibo Accounting Information Disclosure Increase Investor Attention?: Based on the Comparative Study of Main Board and ChiNext
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Social media has become an important channel for information disclosure in the capital market. Whether companies use social media to actually attract investor attention is the focus of all parties. Based on Python and manually collected Weibo accounting information disclosure data of companies on the main board and ChiNext from 2011 to 2016, this paper studies the impact of corporate Weibo accounting information disclosure on investor attention and the difference between the main board and ChiNext. The results show that: (1) The disclosure of (semi-)annual reports on Weibo can immediately increase investor attention; (2) When companies choose to disclose the (semi-)annual reports on Weibo after the official disclosure day, they can continue to increase investor attention for a period of time; (3) Compared with main board companies, Weibo disclosure of ChiNext companies has a greater impact on investor attention.

articleTitle: Game Model and Decision Analysis of Property Logistics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Under the background of information era, booming e-commerce brings about surging package deliveries, and thus urges the express delivery service to speed up and upgrade. However, the distribution problem of last one hundred meters remains the primary reason for restricting the development of express delivery industry. Property logistics is a new type of terminal logistics based on the sharing economy model, and is carried out in collaboration between the property management company and the express company. The establishment of a good property logistics mode has many benefits. It can help cope with the issue of the endpoint distribution, pool the terminal logistics resources to solve the distribution problem of last one hundred meters, expand the scope of property services to diversify the income channels, improve the quality of property service and enhance the core competitiveness, and improve online-shopping customer satisfaction with the express company and the property management company at the delivery address. In search of the best cooperative mode of property logistics, this paper uses game theory to analyze the cooperation strategy between the property management company and the logistics company. It is concluded that on the premise that both parties are willing to establish the property logistics mode, each party should conduct an investigation into its partner's credibility, operating status, customer relationship, profitability, profit space, and etc. prior to signing the contract. Only the selection of a partner with good credibility and operating status can help it make the decision that's best for its own and contribute to establish a favorable property logistics mode.

articleTitle: Managing Obstetrical Appointments with Upgrade and Compensate Decisions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The obstetrical department often has multiple types of wards with unbalanced demand for each type. A so-called “single-room” is significantly more popular than other wards in China. This paper considers an appointment control problem for obstetric patients who mainly request the single-room ward but can be upgraded or downgraded to other wards. We develop an analytical model with decisions to determine the appointment quota months ahead of childbirth and the recursive actions to upgrade or compensate patients on the day of childbirth. We describe the problem formally and find out that the overall revenue is unimodal convexed concerning the appointment quota under a slack condition. Managerial insights are also provided.

articleTitle: Research on Constructing Green Food Traceability Information Management System from the Perspective of Farmers' Behavior
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Green food traceability applies IoT technology to the whole process of agricultural products from production to consumption, and provides a convenient way to build a healthy life through digital means. However, by the end of 2020, the land transfer rate in China was only 36%, and small farmers were still the basic unit of agricultural production. So farmers' behavior choice was the source guarantee of green food. By discussing farmers' behavior characteristics, behavior intention of implementing traceability control, key factors and formation motivation, a green food traceability information management system that farmers are willing to participate in and easy to operate is constructed. Realize the reduction of farmers' opportunism tendency, guide farmers to change the problems of “no standard production and blind investment in pesticides and fertilizers”, realize the quality control of green food source, promote the application of IoT technology in agriculture, and form a green food traceability system of “unified authority, interconnection, information sharing and efficient operation”.

articleTitle: Analysis of development level of Yiwu China-Europe express train based on AHP-TOPSIS model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The pandemic has greatly affected the global transportation industry., but the China-Europe express train is full of opportunities that cannot be repeated. This paper first introduces the development status of Yiwu China-Europe express train in China and the existing ports and channels., and collates relevant data., and then analyzes the characteristics of Yiwu China-Europe express train. Based on five parameters., including the ratio of the container., return rate., run number., program completion rate and transportation safety.,then calculate the weight of parameters reasonably., the AHP-TOPSIS evaluation and analysis were used to compare the top three cases of Yiwu and Chinese cities in 2020. Finally., some specific development suggestions were put forward to promote the healthy development of Yiwu China-Europe freight trains under the continuous influence of the epidemic.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of the Degree of Emergency Linkage of Construction Emergencies in Large-scale Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Large-scale construction projects have a high degree of damage in emergencies, and the emergency rescue capabilities of the project department alone are often insufficient to deal with them. Therefore, the emergency linkage capability is very important in emergencies. First, the research conducted a qualitative analysis of emergency linkage, and constructed a large-scale building emergency linkage indicator system based on dynamic management. According to the emergency system, a large-scale building emergency linkage index model was proposed for the first time, including emergency linkage preparation, emergency linkage disposal and emergency linkage recovery. Finally, an example is used to verify the rationality of the model, and reasonable suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Effects of price regulation and bargaining on pharmaceutical supply chain considering the pharmacy's sales effort
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The characteristics of Internet such as openness and sharing have affected the cooperation and competition between firms in pharmaceutical industry. Considering the pharmacy's sales effort to improve competitiveness, this paper built three models for a two-echelon pharmaceutical supply chain: without regulation (NRNB) model, price cap regulation without bargaining (PRNB) model and price cap regulation with bargaining (PRB) model where the pharmaceutical manufacturer and pharmacy cooperate and bargain on the wholesale price. Based on the optimal pricing and sales effort decisions, the effects of price cap regulation and bargaining on the supply chain and social welfare are explored. The results indicate that the pharmaceutical supply chain, pharmacy and total social welfare will be worse off in the PRNB model. However, in the PRB model, all the pharmaceutical supply chain and firms can be better off, and Pareto improvement is achieved under certain conditions. Moreover, social welfare can also increase in the Pareto zone.

articleTitle: Cost Forecasting of Power Engineering based on RF and SVM optimized by WPA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
