abstract: The improvement of the accuracy of power engineering cost prediction plays a key role in improving the management of power engineering. However, there are many factors that affect the cost of electric power engineering, and the amount of data is relatively small. Therefore, it is very important to accurately predict the cost of electric power projects under high dimensional and small sample conditions. The random forest algorithm (RF) is used to mine the data, and the redundant indexes are eliminated effectively. The optimization of support vector machine (SVM) model by using wolf pack algorithm (WPA) effectively solves the problems of SVM overfitting and easily falling into local optimality, which improves the accuracy and stability of the power project cost prediction. By example analysis and comparison with other models, it is proved that the proposed method has better prediction performance.

articleTitle: The Assessment of Costco Management Strategy in Chinese Market Based on Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, the characteristics of supply chain management (SCM) have been greatly modified owing to prosperous of the E-commerce. Costco, as a well known fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) company, faces plenty of SCM issues when it enters the Chinese market under the impact of E-commerce. On this basis, we select Costco as a typical case and put forward corresponding suggestions for overcoming the SCM issues under the “Internet Plus” era. Specifically, this paper first summarizes the significance and importance of enterprise, supplier, and consumer management to SCM. Subsequently, as for the case study of Costco, we defined the research scope in China and the research business as a supermarket chain. The research methods include data research and investigation method, directional comparison method, and chart method. Finally, it is concluded that Costco's problems mainly include weak external suppliers, high internal costs, the impact of local consumer culture, and the market competition environment. Therefore, suggestions are proposed in two aspects accordingly: (1) business management; (2) competitors and outer environment. These results offer a guideline for the supply chain management strategy of Costco and similar companies.

articleTitle: Optimization of Pumped Storage Power Station and New Energy Units in Power Grid Based on HOMER Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The paper studies the optimal configuration of pumped storage power station and new energy units in the power grid with the help of HOMER software. Firstly, summarize the power grid planning with pumped storage power stations and new energy units. Secondly, sort out the objectives of power grid planning, and clarify the boundary conditions and related constraints of the problem. Then, describe the operation principle of the Homer software briefly. Finally, list 3~5 power grid coordinated schemes of pumped storage power station and new energy units, analysis each scheme with running the HOMER model. When running the HOMER, input load demand data, power generation resource data as well as the technical parameters of power grid components. According to the calculation results of HOMER, the optimal power grid coordinated scheme of pumped storage power station and new energy units under specific scenarios is obtained.

articleTitle: Sleep Signal Data Analysis Based on SVM and Markov Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Traditional sleep score requires psychologists to make manual judgments through polysomnography (PSG). The collection of PSG requires multiple sensors, which makes sleep work lack of convenience. In this paper, we propose a sleep score method based on single channel EEG signal. It helps to reduce sleep discomfort caused by too many sensors. Our method consists of three parts: feature extraction, classification, and sleep sequence optimization. The proposed method combines support vector machine algorithm (SVM) and hidden Markov model (HMM). We conducted experiments on the two EEG channels Fpz-Cz and Pz-Oz, and achieved excellent performance. Experimental results show that our model can be used as a solution for single-channel EEG sleep scoring.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of Logistics Listed Enterprises Based on entropy weight TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: As an emerging industry in the complex service industry, the objective evaluation of business performance is particularly important for the transformation and upgrading of the logistics industry and the sustainable development of enterprises. This paper selects 12 listed logistics enterprises. Twelve indicators are selected from the five dimensions of profitability, debt paying ability, operation ability, innovation ability and development ability to construct the enterprise operation performance evaluation index system. Entropy method is used to determine the index weight. TOPSIS is used to rank the business performance of enterprises. The results show that the development of logistics enterprises is not balanced. There is still room for improvement of business performance. Based on this, some suggestions are put forward to improve business performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Cooperative Game Between Fresh E-commerce and Logistics Service Providers Considering Green and Fresh Recycling Incubator Input Based on MATLAB Software
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Considering the perishability of fresh products, the circulation incubator at the end of the distribution can better maintain the freshness of products, and at the same time respond to the national requirements for environmental protection, to attract more consumers with green awareness to buy. Therefore, based on consumers' preference for fresh agricultural products freshness and green, this paper constructs the profit function of fresh e-commerce and logistics service providers to explore the impact of the investment level of incubator on the income of fresh e-commerce and logistics service providers under the two decision-making modes of centralized decision and decentralized decision. Through Matlab to solve the results showed that the centralized decision results better than the decentralized decision making, cycle incubator investment and gross profit of supply chain and consumer freshness and the green preference coefficient is sensitive coefficient, as consumer freshness sensitive coefficient and the green preference coefficient increases, can improve the circulation incubator in the gross profit of supply chain.

articleTitle: Equilibrium distribution model of benefits of multi-entity cooperation considering Shapley's value method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the gradual development of marketization, the participation of multiple subjects in cooperation becomes the norm, and fair and reasonable benefits are one of the important methods to stabilize cooperative alliances, but the traditional method of benefits allocation, which is based on transaction volume only, cannot reflect the important roles of different subjects in alliance cooperation. Therefore, this paper firstly researches the role positioning of multiple subjects in benefit allocation, constructs a benefit base allocation method based on the Shapley value method, and builds an improved allocation method based on the introduction of cost, contribution and risk factors; finally, based on actual cases, thermal power operators, gas turbine operators and wind power operators are selected as multiple subjects in power supply, and various scenarios are set up for arithmetic analysis. The results show that using the comprehensive improved Shapley value method for benefit allocation can enhance the benefits of important partners in cooperative alliances, reflect their important collaborative value in cooperative alliances, and promote the stability of cooperative alliances.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive energy market maturity evaluation model and market deduction from the perspective of power grid company
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: How to evaluate the maturity of China's comprehensive energy market and study the current situation of China's comprehensive energy market maturity have become one of the major problems to be solved in the field of comprehensive energy service technology. Scientific evaluation of the maturity of the comprehensive energy market will help to enrich the maturity theory of the comprehensive energy market and enrich the maturity evaluation index system of the comprehensive energy market, explore the problems exposed in the process of market operation and the accumulated successful experience, and provide a theoretical basis for the construction of China's unified comprehensive energy market. Firstly, this paper studies the key factors affecting the maturity of comprehensive energy market, and constructs an index system to reflect its maturity; Then, through the combination of subjective and objective methods, customer service determines the deficiency of index weight subjectively, and constructs the market maturity evaluation model of comprehensive energy market on this basis; Finally, by constructing the model and expert scoring prediction, the development of integrated energy service industry is divided into four stages: market incubation period, market rise period, market maturity period and market stability period. After dividing the development stages of the integrated energy trading market, the integrated energy trading market is deduced by studying the characteristics of each stage of the integrated energy trading market, which is the key process activity to improve the maturity level of the integrated energy trading market, so as to provide reference for the development and continuous maturity of the integrated energy market.

articleTitle: Optimization of Multi-Vehicle Distribution Path under Complex Road Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Based on the existing multi-vehicle routing optimization model, a multi-objective distribution model for minimizing comprehensive cost and maximizing distribution efficiency was established on the basis of considering the impact of complex road conditions to the optimal solution. At the same time, the genetic algorithm was used to solve the multi-objective distribution model under the complex road traffic conditions. By comparing and analyzing, the results showed that the optimal distribution path obtained by solving the multi-vehicle distribution optimization model under complex road conditions was better than that obtained by solving the single vehicle distribution optimization model.

articleTitle: Identification and Classification of Risk Factors in Municipal Engineering Based on JHA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Municipal engineering has always been an important part of the construction industry. Due to the lack of research on the classification of risk factors earlier, safety accidents in municipal engineering are not uncommon and have not been effectively contained. This paper introduced the JHA method of risk management theory. It was carried on of the risk identification and classification of the road traffic engineering project and the underground pipeline engineering in the typical municipal engineering. It was found that the risks of the two projects have common points, including unsafe behaviors of personnel, unsafe conditions of machinery and equipment, poor operating conditions, and complex external environments. However, they both have different risk factors. Road traffic projects have more risk points than underground pipeline projects. The former's safety management is stronger than the latter. This implied that the risk factor categories of municipal engineering also need to be further refined.

articleTitle: Coal Logistics Demand Forecasting Based on Grey System in Shanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Shanxi is one of the areas where coal was first discovered and seasonably utilized in China. However, in recent years, the development of coal industry is facing great challenges in Shanxi Province because of the slow economic growth rate and the adjustment of energy structure. This paper analyzes the current situation of coal production and transportation in Shanxi Province. Then, the grey system is used to establish a prediction model to predict the coal logistics demand of Shanxi Province by 2024. The aim of the prediction is to make the supply and transportation of coal resources more reasonable in Shanxi. Meanwhile, it has far-reaching significance for the development of energy economy in China.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of BIM Technology in the Whole Process Management of Project Cost: Focus on the application of BIM technology in the preparation of construction drawing budget of Shenzhen Lingzhi Park Expansion and Upgrade Comprehensive Reconstruction Project (Phase I) as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The whole process of project cost management is cumbersome, involving various costs in the project and involving multiple interests. The lack of an effective cost information sharing platform for project participants has led to many loopholes in the process of project cost management. In order to strengthen the level of project cost management, management personnel advocate the use of BIM technology to realize the whole process management of project cost. The biggest feature of BIM technology is the large amount of information carried in the architectural model. From the decision-making stage, design stage, bidding stage, construction stage to the completion and acceptance stage of the project, all the information will be gathered in a three-dimensional model information database. Through the visualization and virtualization of the BIM model and other functions, it is conducive to the whole process management of the project cost by all parties involved in the project, and provides a good guarantee for the effective improvement of the project cost management efficiency.

articleTitle: The Impact of PPP Mode on Poverty Alleviation: A Difference-in-Difference Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: PPP mode mobilizes the enthusiasm of social capital, and supplements the shortcomings of funds through innovative financial methods to promote supply-side structural reforms. Meanwhile, poverty alleviation is an important task for China to achieve common prosperity. After years of construction and promotion, it has become a trend to combine the PPP mode with poverty alleviation, but the effectiveness of applying the PPP mode to poverty alleviation needs to be verified. Therefore, this paper uses panel data from 30 counties in Sichuan Province, China from 2009 to 2017, and adopts the DID method to study the impact of the implementation of the PPP mode on regional economic development. The empirical results show that: first, the implementation of the PPP mode has significantly promoted the growth of regional GDP and GDP per capita. This result is still valid after the robustness test. Second, the implementation of the PPP mode is mainly to promote local economic development by optimizing the industrial structure and rationally planning regional general fiscal expenditures.

articleTitle: Electronic Archives Management for Large-scale Cross-sea Infrastructures based on Project Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Large-scale cross-sea projects have huge construction scale, complex engineering technology, long construction period, and multiple participants. The traditional archives management methods are difficult to meet the requirements in terms of standardization and synchronization. Firstly, this study establishes a project management platform that allows electronic documents to be generated simultaneously with the construction process. Finally, the electronic documents generated in the management platform are automatically collected by an electronic archives management system. This platform greatly improves the quality and efficiency of electronic archives management.

articleTitle: Hub location-allocation problem considering whether passing through hub or not based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: As an important node of express delivery network, hub location has gradually become the focus of cross-border logistics enterprises. Based on the location of the ports and terminal service centers, the volume of express delivery, the cost advantage brought by economies of scale and other information, this paper reasonably plans the location and quantity, and designs a set of reasonable logistics distribution network system. In this paper, the distribution cost is considered, and the existing terminal service center is expanded into a hub center. Gap statistics is used to determine the number of distribution centers required, the initial location of the hubs is given by K-means clustering, and the optimal location of hubs is obtained by Genetic Algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on User-oriented Product Development Mode of Systematic Weapon and Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: For the systematic weapon and equipment, it is necessary to design the combat scenarios equipment system composition and functions, and combat mode from the user's point of view at the early stage of design. It brings new challenge to the product development model. A user-oriented product development mode of systematic weapon and equipment is proposed. Firstly, the fuctional requirements of systematic weapon and equipment are analyzed. Then, the systematic weapon equipment product promotion process that user can participate in the whole process is proposed. It includes six steps, designing combat scenarios, building equipment systems, establishing system indicators, measuring system indicators, evaluating capability improvements and designing product scheme. The process can be iterated according to user's response. At last, a systematic weapon and equipment product design model is proposed, which subdivides from three dimensions: design, function, physics, so as to guide the accurate positioning and development of products. A two-stage product scheme is designed by using the product developing model. By comparing the mapping of the two stages in three dimensions, it can be seen that the model can effectively guide product design in improving user's stickiness, product profit margin and brand positioning.

articleTitle: Research on the environment-economy-technical comprehensive benefit evaluation method of typical sludge treatment technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The study aims to evaluate the environmental impact, economic cost and technical performance through sanitary landfill, single incineration, anaerobic digestion and aerobic fermentation, evaluate the environment-economic-technical benefit by using AHP-VIKOR method, and finally the results were tested by TOPSIS method. The results show that aerobic fermentation <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{(\mathrm{Q}=0.0000)}$</tex> is ideal for resource recovery of sludge disposal, followed by anaerobic digestion <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{(\mathrm{Q}=0.2860).}$</tex> TOPSIS test found agreement with VIKOR results and the computational model was stable.

articleTitle: Analysis and improvement of equipment maintenance management fee allocation efficiency based on DEA theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Analysis and evaluation and improvement of equipment maintenance management fee allocation efficiency for effectively alleviating the contradiction between supply and demand of funds, promoting equipment construction development and improving the combat effectiveness of troops has important military and economic significance. Combined with the current equipment maintenance management fee input characteristics, the output-oriented CRS model and VRS model of equipment maintenance management fee configuration efficiency analysis are constructed by using data envelopment analysis (DEA) theory, and the efficiency of the sample unit's allocation is evaluated through example analysis, the reasons for the low allocation efficiency are analyzed, and the corresponding suggestions for improvement are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on The Industrial Chain Reorganization of Taiwan Enterprises in Fujian By FNN Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the main problems and difficulties faced by the economy of our province after the COVID-19, and probes into the effective countermeasures to accelerate the improvement of our province's economy through many field investigations inside and outside the province. Team is the purpose of the investigation research in new outbreaks that Taiwanese traditional entity industry under the condition of shock, assist the governments at all levels to develop more ground gas industry guidance and the support policy, optimize the business environment, help in fujian and Taiwan companies survive, enables companies to seize the development opportunity of outbreak of the global crisis, bold reform, restructuring, transformation and upgrading and complete industry chain Embrace domestic demand market in mainland China and actively integrate into the new pattern of national double-cycle development; so that Taiwan enterprises can get better development in the mainland. This paper focuses on the Research on the industrial chain reorganization of Taiwan enterprises in Fujian after the impact of the epidemic. After thorough investigation and analysis, the research group put forward several feasible schemes.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of supply chain relationship on enterprise innovation under the background of digital economy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The traditional view holds that social capital plays an important role in promoting enterprise innovation. However, as digital technology continuously developed, the sharing platform and collaborative mechanism built with it as the core make enterprise innovation more efficient and convenient, thus weakening the dependence on social capital. Therefore, in the context of the development of digital convergence, the impact of social capital, that is, relational trading model, on enterprise innovation is worthy of further research. This paper uses the data of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2012 to 2020 as a research sample to explore the impact of supply chain relationships on corporate innovation from the perspective of resource effects. Conclusions indicate that: the higher the concentration of the supply chain, the lower the level of enterprise innovation; The specific impact mechanism is that high concentration of the supply chain will increase cost stickiness, stimulate “tunneling”, and cause misallocation and encroachment of corporate resources. And then hinder enterprise innovation; Further test based on the external environment-digital finance-find that the centralized supply chain relationship has a more obvious inhibitory effect on innovation in areas with a high degree of digital finance; Test based on the internal characteristics-political connection-find that the stronger the political connection, the weaker the inhibitory effect of the supply chain relationship on the enterprise innovation. Conclusions in this paper can not only provide ideas for the optimization of supply chain value from the perspective of acceleraating the digital finance-driven industry, but also provide decision-making enlightenment for enhancing enterprise innovation.

articleTitle: The Impact of COVID-19 on Undergraduate Student's Well-being Based on Multilevel Spatially-Allocated Time Use Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: To reveal the impact of campus epidemic prevention and control policy on undergraduate students' well-being, time use survey of D University before and during COVID-19 were investigated. Multilevel spatially-allocated time use model was established to describe undergraduate students' well-being. The results show undergraduate students' well-being during COVID-19 decreases from 0.31 before COVID-19 to −0.93. The spatial choice of daily activities significantly affects students' well-being. The difference of intrinsic utility of self-study and leisure in teaching area (5.70) is significantly higher than that in the dormitory area (0.29) and outside campus (0.61), which indicates that there is a large room for improvement in the built environment of leisure activities in D University. Takeout service can save undergraduates' time and physical strength. However, the habit of dormitory dining reduces undergraduates' overall happiness index. In the long perspective, undergraduate students' well-being with better physical heath, mental health or active time use mode has a significant downward trend, which will lead to the change of their original efficient decision-making mechanism. Improving built environment for students' leisure activities, ameliorating campus dining services, organizing group activities can provide diversified choices for students to effectively improve their well-being during COVID-19.

articleTitle: Research on Data Classification of Intelligent Connected Vehicles Based on Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The intelligent connected vehicle industry has entered a period of opportunity, industry data is accumulating rapidly, and the formulation of industry standards to regulate big data management and application is imminent. As the basis of data security, data classification has received unprecedented attention. By combing through the research and development status of data classification in various industries, this article combines industry characteristics and re-examines the framework of industry data classification from the aspects of information security and data assetization, and tries to find the balance point between data security and data value. The intelligent networked automobile industry provides support for big data applications, this article combines the characteristics of the connected vehicle industry, re-examines the data characteristics of the intelligent connected vehicle industry from the 2 aspects as information security and data assetization, and eventually proposes a scene-based hierarchical framework. The framework includes the complete classification process, model, and quantifiable parameters, which provides a solution and theoretical endorsement for the construction of a big data automatic classification system for the intelligent connected vehicle industry and safe data open applications.

articleTitle: Research on Product Diffusion in Social Commerce Based on Improved SEIR Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The diffusion of social commerce products is largely affected by the information shared by users. Positive information promotes the diffusion of social commerce products, while negative information will hinder the diffusion of products, resulting in the potential failure of product diffusion. Exploring the problem of product diffusion in social commerce is of great significance to promote the development of social commerce, and can provide guidance for businesses to formulate strategies to promote product diffusion. Based on the analysis of the process of product diffusion in social commerce, this paper uses SEIR model of infectious diseases for reference to build a model of product diffusion in social commerce, and builds a simulation network based on the data of social commerce platform. Multi agent simulation is used to visually analyze the inherent law of product diffusion in social commerce. The results show that: the diffusion process of social commerce products approximately presents ‘S’ type growth and has obvious periodicity; The credibility of user information, individual activity and the influence of key opinion leaders all have an impact on product diffusion in social commerce.

articleTitle: Analysis and Empirical Study on Influencing Factors of Hotel Customer Satisfaction based on Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to ascertain the factors influencing the rating of hotels. With the continuous development of tourism, the hotel industry has also developed with it, and the competition has become more intense. If a hotel wants to be preeminent, its owner needs to know where and how they could improve to satisfy customers. We prefer to determine whether factors of hotel location, guest type, room qualities, and cleanliness will influence customer satisfaction of hotels. In this research paper, using a dataset containing many different hotels, we will utilize three methods to explore this study: methods of literature research, case study, and modelling. Then we analyze important indicators such as r-squared values and z-scores from several multiple linear regression models using different predictors to test the factors that might influence the rating of hotels. We will also make graphs based on different models and predictors to make the influences more visible. Finally, we conclude that room qualities and hotel cleanliness are the two main factors influencing the hotel rating. Possible solutions to improve the satisfaction levels are introduced, including standard cleaning training, transportation service, and customized service.

articleTitle: Factors and Potential Solutions of High Turnover Rates of Tech Companies and Based on Mathematical Statistics Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The technology industry is known for its high turn-over rate. This paper focuses on the factors contributing to the high turn-over rate in the Technology industry and gives the appropriate recommendations to the corresponding factors. The paper utilizes three methods to analyze this situation: Literature Research, Comparative Analysis, and Case Study. Through these methods, we can perform both quantitative and qualitative analysis through analysis of the data, statistical significance testing. In the quantitative testings, we have gathered data from multiple sources and developed our own hypothesis tests to see the significance in different factors' relationships with turn-over rate. Through the data analysis, we have concluded several factors that have major impacts on the high turn-over rate in the Technology industry. These factors are organizational commitment, job-seeking behavior, quality of management, company culture/environment, and high-competitive hiring in the expanding technical field. Due to the high costs (both implicit and explicit ones) of employee resignation for the Information Technology (IT) companies, we have proposed strategies for them to better keep the employees through updating the current management system by giving the employees more freedom in making decisions, providing a more relaxing working environment and signing contracts that are more binding in terms of the time of stay. This paper aids to give the employees a clearer idea about the company's culture and thus help to generate a better communication system between the employer and the employees. We want to help both the employees and the IT companies improve their current collaboration system to make the work more enjoyable for both parties.

articleTitle: Research on WeChat Service Contents of Public Libraries Based on Co-occurrence Relationship of Items
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: WeChat public account has become an important part of microservice system of public libraries, and its service content setting is the key to affect the WeChat service quality of public libraries. This paper takes provincial public libraries as research objects, combining content analysis and social network analysis methods to analyze the collected data. The classification system of WeChat service content is summarized on the basic of content analysis, and the association network is constructed to explore service contents' relative importance and correlation based on their co-occurrence relationship. The results show that basic service contents' relative importance is higher, while featured service contents' relative importance is lower. At last, suggestions on service content setting are proposed.

articleTitle: Energy-saving and environmental protection technologies in civil engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: There is a significant change toward sustainability and a stronger motivation to pursue the most sustainable way of life, especially in the building construction sector, primarily responsible for the current environmental problems. To reduce energy consumption, optimize the building structure would be an efficient method. Especially steel and reinforcement structure are the main construction forms in many projects. The current steel structure includes a multi-layer multi-span frame structure, interlace truss structure, cold-formed thin-walled steel structure, and metal arch corrugated Roo structure systems. The steel structure is characterized by light weight, high strength, high elastic modulus, and superior seismic and bending resistance. Furthermore, concrete plays a very important role in the construction industry, causing plenty of environmental issues and consuming a sheer amount of energy. This study introduces three different materials for replacement or substitutes for the concrete, including recycled aggregate, volcanic powder, and abode brick. Instead of consuming the energy and raw material, the renewable energy ‘solar energy’ has also been implemented in most building construction. It could support the heating and lighting system of a building in most cases. Passive solar houses and solar water heating systems are two effective methods to save power energy and reduce pollution.

articleTitle: Estimation of earthquake disaster risk loss based on AHP method in western China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: In today's society, earthquake has brought many hazards to us, including but not limited to building collapse, landslide, soil damage, tsunami, fire and so on. These disasters have taken a heavy toll on our economy. Therefore, from reducing disaster loss to reducing disaster risk, the research on earthquake disaster assessment is the foundation. In this paper, based on the four factors of earthquake risk, exposure degree of disaster-bearing body, vulnerability of disaster-bearing body and ability of earthquake resistance and mitigation, and 12 factors of earthquake intensity and frequency, a risk assessment model of earthquake disaster in western China is constructed, and an evaluation index system is determined. The risk of earthquake disaster in six western provinces of China is evaluated by analytic hierarchy process (AHP), and the evaluation results are compared and analyzed. The results show that each index factor has different influence on the risk disaster in different provinces. The main factors that affect the risk of earthquake disaster in Xizang are the frequency and intensity of earthquake and the natural growth rate of population. The frequency, intensity and unemployment rate of earthquake are the main factors that affect the risk of earthquake disaster in Xinjiang. By analyzing the influence degree of each index on earthquake disaster risk, the weak links of disaster prevention and mitigation in this area can be understood. Among them, earthquake risk is the main factor that causes earthquake disaster risk, and the exposure and vulnerability of the disaster bearing body are also important factors. The risk of earthquake disaster in western China is different. Sichuan province is at the highest risk, while Qinghai province is at the lowest. The evaluation results can provide the decision-making basis for the government to strengthen the management of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction, and reduce the risk of earthquake disaster reasonably and as far as possible.

articleTitle: Optimization of Pork-Entering-Beijing Cold Chain Logistics Mode by IoT and Management reform: Based on the Investigation and Study of Pork- Entering-Beijing from a Slaughter House in Shenyang, Liaoning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: This paper performs an in-depth investigation and study of the pork-entering-Beijing cold chain logistics mode under the influence of the “African swine fever (ASF)” epidemic and summarizes the process. In view of the current situation, this article puts forward four suggestions for improving the cold chain logistics mode. Namely, the digital and intelligent transformation of pork cold chain, perfecting the standards and specifications regarding the transportation, realizing whole-chain information traceability and optimizing the supervision measures. These suggestions combine logistics with technologies such as the Internet of Things, block chain, image recognition and so on to strengthen the depth and professionalism of technology application, and to solve the current problems in the logistics process.

articleTitle: Analysis of Campus Fire Based on Bayes Network in the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: In recent years, fire accidents have increased year by year, especially on-campus fires. At the same time, the dense population, the aging of campus buildings and equipment, and the poor safety awareness of students have led to frequent fire accidents, causing huge losses. Therefore, scientific statistics and evaluation of the safety level of the campus are helpful to find out the cause of the fire on the campus and carry out the corresponding prevention. Starting our research from the current situation of campus fires in China, this article is based on big fire data, combined with Bayes network calculations, collected a large number of cases of campus fires in China and other countries, and used the fault tree to construct campus fires, which under the influence of various factors. The Bayes networks model can estimate the probability of fire accident consequences. This model can estimate the probability of the effects of fire accidents and then use Bayes' powerful probabilistic reasoning ability to calculate the probabilities of various factors that cause fires. These analyses can fully explore the potential relationships between various factors so as to predict the cause of fire better. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Joint Stowage and Crane Planning Decision for Steel Products
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Ship stowage planning and quay crane scheduling are the main stages that affect the efficiency of steel ship operation on the terminal side. In previous studies, the two stages of optimization are separated. In this paper, a joint optimization model of mixed integer programming is established. By optimizing the stowage planning of steel products at the same time and the sequence of the crane scheduling, the makespan of the ship operation is reduced. For the joint optimization, we first propose the pregrouping of various types of steel products and the stacking of cargo groups. Then we regard the ship's cabin as the operation task of quay crane. In the solution, we propose a formula based on one-dimensional loading to linearize the limit of cabin space capacity and use the number of rows to represent the length of the cargo stack in the cabin, which is simplified as line segment. Finally, the commercial solver CPLEX is used to solve the joint optimization model. Numerical experiments show that the proposed joint optimization model is effective in solving practical problems of steel ship operation compared with the previous phased optimization.

articleTitle: The Visualization Analysis of the Research Status of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Facing a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial reform, many localities have been accelerate the layout of development strategy of artificial intelligence. In order for a good understanding of the research status in the field of artificial intelligence, this paper takes the papers published in the core journals of the two databases, the Web of Science and CNKI, as the data sources, and uses the visualization software, CiteSpace, to analyze time distribution, spatial cooperation, authors' cooperation and hot topics and so on. After the analysis, the obtained results show that: First, the artificial intelligence research both in China and abroad are still in a period of rapid development, and is widely infiltrated and applied in engineering, environment, agriculture, education, intelligence and other fields. Second, Ilia State University, Ton Duc Thang University, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University and Jilin University jointly form the core force of artificial intelligence research with the prolific scholars from these institutions. Third, the hot topics of artificial intelligence research focus on support vector machines, genetic algorithms, computer simulation, robots, computer vision, neural networks, etc.

articleTitle: Nansha Time Bank Service Requests Analysis Based on Imbalanced Binary Classification Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The rapid development of time banking, which is due to the aggravating trend of aging population in China, has attracted much more attention on time bank models. However, the analytical studies on the historical request data of time bank models are still limited. In this paper, we collected the historical volunteer service request data from Nansha Time Bank website through crawlers, from which we dug out the inherent laws of request. By comparing the learning effect of Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF) and Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) combined with methods like under-sampling and cost-sensitive learning, we studied the imbalance classification problem and recognized the characteristics of service data request. Based on the analysis, we gave advice on the optimization direction for the time bank platform, hoping that there will be a positive impact on improving this new model of mutual assistance in the elderly and the community.

Author Keywords: time bank mutual aid pension model

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Management Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Gradually appearing project management, low efficiency of management, information management problems such as fault, backward management tools, the traditional way of management has been difficult to adapt to the development of modern engineering needs, so in this paper, through the literature research, a multidisciplinary approach, case analysis, will be introduced to the management synergy theory of project management. The construction collaborative management framework with BIM technology as the core is designed from the perspective of time and space, and the design-construction management is servo-analyzed. At the same time combined with the actual project case analysis, to explore efficient management mode in the future has a certain reference significance.

articleTitle: Influential Factors on Total Revenue of New Product: A Case Study of Smartfood Company Based on Mathematical Statistics Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: COVID-19's emergence has caused an impact on a large number of manufacturers and industries. While some past research is no longer time-efficient, as an emerging industry, the healthy food market research resources are not sufficient. This study aims to explore what factors could affect the total revenue of the new product. In order to find the best results, this paper reviewed previous studies and, on the basis of literature review, adopted a regression model to test the data. The data used in this paper are all provided by Smartfood Company. Due to the small number of data samples, this paper does not clean the raw data. Through regression analysis of the data, this paper builds a linear regression model and identifies the factors that have a significant impact on the total revenue of healthy food form Smartfood Company. The final results show that the Smartfood Co.'s revenue would be influenced by four explanatory to varying degrees, including price, advertising, product location in stores, and store volume. This finding basically consists of the hypothesis and the previous research, which also proves the reliability of this conclusion for the side. The research results of this paper can provide new ideas for the sales strategy of Smartfood Co.

articleTitle: Employee Strategic Commitment And Strategic Executive Performance: The Mediating Effect of Strategic Execution: Based on Experimental and Mathematical Statistics Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: In the existing research on strategic consensus, there is not enough in-depth research on the role of employee strategic consensus on strategic implementation performance. From the perspective of strategic execution, based on the logical relationship of strategic consensus, strategic execution and performance, this paper explores the action mechanism of employee strategic commitment on enterprise strategic execution performance. In this study, SPSS24.0 was used to analyze the reliability and validity of the questionnaire. AMOS23.0 was used to establish the structural equation model. Employees' strategic commitment, strategic execution and strategic execution performance were three potential variables. The questionnaire design questions were observation variables to determine the relationship between potential variables, draw the relationship diagram, and import the questionnaire data to run to obtain the structural equation model diagram, The coefficients of each path are obtained, and the relationship between employees' strategic commitment, strategic execution and strategic execution performance is tested. Through the bootstrap test method, the 95% confidence interval of the regression coefficient product term does not include 0, which further tests the intermediary effect of strategic execution. The research results confirm the relationship between employees' strategic commitment, strategic execution and strategic execution performance, clarify the action path of employees' strategic commitment on strategic execution performance, provide theoretical reference for enterprise strategic adjustment and strategic implementation practice under the influence of new environment and target policies, and enrich the research of strategic consensus theory.

articleTitle: A visual comparative analysis of research progress on digital transformation in China and other countries
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Digital transformation has become one of the current areas of widespread interest among scholars in China and other countries. This paper uses a combination of quantitative and qualitative approaches to systematically compare and analyze 403 foreign and 302 Chinese literatures from 2008 to 2020 in terms of research foundations, research hotspots and research trends, and to grasp the similarities, differences and development trends of their research progress. The research results show that: (1) In recent years, both China and foreign research as a whole has shown rapid development, but the high citation characteristics of foreign literature are obvious, and there are strong collaborative relationships among scholars, and some cooperative groups have begun to form;(2) Both China and foreign research pay attention to the driving role of digital technology for digital transformation at the technical level, the supporting role of national related strategies at the macro level, and the transformation of enterprises at the micro level;(3) In terms of research trends, the continuity of foreign research content is stronger, the system is in a state of gradual improvement, and more emphasis is placed on the driving role of digital technology. In recent years, China has begun to increase research on data governance. On this basis, this paper elaborates and outlooks future research directions based on four dimensions: Chinese scenario, dual dimension of technology and management, influencing factors and behavioral strategies, common problems and individual needs.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient and Sustainable Construction Technologies and Simulation Optimisation Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: As a key part of sustainable urban development, constructing buildings and other infrastructures using sustainable technologies and materials is a key research field to minimize energy consumption and seek to combat climate change. This study introduced several feasible energy-efficient and environmental-friendly materials and methods, including roof gardening, advanced and recycled materials, green interior decoration, and simulation optimisation measures. Roof gardening is a kind of promising roof form that makes the functions of purifying air quality, energy conserving, and reshape the urban ecosystems all possible. However, the market still needs more encouragement from the government to better implementation in the city. Advanced materials and waste reuse materials are two key aspects of green building materials in energy saving and environment protection. The advanced material of photocatalytic self-cleaning glass has been fully applied; However, TiO2 self-cleaning glass and waste reuse materials such as rubber, straw, bamboo have some degrees of limitations due to economic and distribution constraints. The interior decoration combined with environmentally friendly materials is of great significance to enhance energy usage and environmental quality. Some new environmental protection inventions such as LED lights and artificial intelligence technologies are the main development direction in interior decoration in the future. Utilizing computer simulation and optimisation to minimize the building life cycle environmental impacts has also gained increasing attentions recently. Regarding design optimisation, emerging digital technologies (e.g., neural network, data-driven design and parametric 3D modelling, multi-disciplinary optimisation) are enablers for greater automation in early design exploration and should be encouraged in sustainable design optimisation.

articleTitle: Study on the Influencing Factors of the Elderly's Participation Willingness in Mutual Support Based on Text Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Because mutual support didn't make its effect in aging China, this work aims at finding out the factors that affect the elderly's participation in mutual support. We propose the influencing factors model using text mining to identify the main factors from massive data sources and analyze their evolutions. The model exhibits: environmental factors, individual factors, project attributes and incentive utility influence the elderly's participation willingness in mutual support. Then, based on the model, we propose some suggestions to promote the elderly to participate in mutual support, and to provide reference for policy makers.

articleTitle: Exploration of Quality Function Deployment Transfer Function in Community Group-buying Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: As a new business model, community group-buying has created a new supply chain with the group-leader as the innovative point. However, each part of the community group-buying supply chain sustains losses in business. This problem needs to be solved urgently, especially for small and middle enterprises in the supply chain. Because of the lack of research of community group-buying about supply chain, this paper analyses this research hot spot from the perspective of supply chain based on Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Quality Function Deployment (QFD). According to the results of the consumer questionnaire, this study sorted the customer requirements by matrix calculation based on AHP method. Next, this research achieves the importance ranking of key influencing factors from downstream to upstream of the supply chain based on QFD transfer function between HoQs. Finally, this study proposes three improvement measures, including the training of group-leader, information sharing, and purchase cost, to improve the overall supply chain profit based on the case study. The research results make great significance to the actual operation of community group-buying due to the real operational data and situation. This study is a forerunner from a new perspective to study community group-buying, which is of great significance to the development of community group-buying.

articleTitle: EFA-based Research on Key Factors in Building Safety Culture in State-owned Construction Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: As safety culture for construction enterprises keeps advancing, employees are paying more attention to safe construction, but the frequency and severity of accidents cannot be ignored. To find out what factors influence safety culture within a construction enterprise, this paper chose 14 factors from the three perspectives of execution, organization and leadership. By analyzing 1285 valid questionnaires obtained from employees of different regions and titles within a large state-owned construction enterprise, we have a basic understanding of how important these factors are to corporate safety culture. Based on factor analysis, we found that the three factors, execution, organization and leadership, all of which exert influences on the corporate safety culture. Among them, execution serve as a key factor. The result of this study can surely provide theoretical guidance and suggestions for improving corporate safety culture.

articleTitle: Study on Elderly Care Service and Knowledge Distribution Based on Visual Measurement Analysis and Content Analysis: From Web of Science Literature Data (2010-2020)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: By clustering of the last decade literature data from Web of Science database, we use CiteSpace5.6 R5, which is mainly based on co-citation analysis theory, Pathfinder algorithm and Minimum Spanning Tree algorithm (MST), to generate mapping knowledge domains of keyword and citation as well as analyze current research focus in the field of elderly care service. We also combine the method of visual bibliometrics and content analysis to make full sense of the relationship of network, structure, interaction, crossover, evolution or derivation among elderly care services. In a conclusion, we find that (1) The keywords about informal care, Medicaid, quality, social security, have higher keyword frequency and keyword centrality, which shows that these keywords are the research focus in this period of 2010–2020. Also, the research field of elderly care service can be divided into two stages. In 2010-2015, researchers focused on aging issues and care-givers in nursing homes. In 2016-present, researchers focused on informal care and the needs of the elderly. (2) the knowledge distribution is constituted by the selection of elderly care methods, elderly care insurance, saving and consumption behavior of the elderly and quality of elderly care.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Management Demand, Transformation, and Realization Path of Guangdong Residents - Based on A Logistic Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: Through survey statistics and data analysis of Guangdong residents, with the help of binary logistic regression model, we empirically analyze the key factors that affect residents' needs and realize the transformation of financial management. Research indicates, among the residents' internal factors, residents' educational level and annual incomes (after-tax) have a significant impact on residents' financial needs and the realization of financial transformation. Among the external factors of residents, the choices of people around and the recommendations of specialists have a significant impact on the transformation of residents' financial needs and the realization of financial transformation. Profits from financial products has a significant impact on residents' financial transformation. Government functional departments, colleges and universities, and financial institutions should adjust from investor education, financial basic service systems, and product and service innovation to promote the transformation of residents' financial management.

articleTitle: Study on the Selection of the Optimal Design Partner of EPC Project Consortium Led by the Construction Party
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: As China is vigorously promoting general engineering contracting, a project consortium contracted by the design party and the construction party is an inevitable choice in this transitional stage. This paper studies how to choose the optimal design partner of EPC project consortium from the perspective of the construction party. By establishing a design partner selection indicator system for EPC project consortium, taking account of the effect of psychological factors on decision-making, introducing prospect theory, constructing a gray relational TOPSIS optimization model based on prospect theory and using actual cases, the case study shows that selection model based on prospect theory is more in accordance with decision-making preference. And provides reference for the construction party in selecting design partner of EPC project consortium.

Author Keywords: selection of project consortium design partner

articleTitle: Analysis of the Value Equation of ROBAM Appliances Co., Ltd.'s Domestic Supply Chain in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: With the growth of economic globalization, supply chain management (SCM) has become an important strategy for contemporary enterprises to maintain and enhance their competitive advantages. As a world-renowned manufacturer of kitchen appliances, ROBAM has experienced more than 30 years of development, and the core of the company's strategy has undergone tremendous changes. This paper constructs a value equation model of ROBAM supply chain management through field research, interviews, and information retrieval. The current status of ROBAM supply chain management is examined, including cost, working capital, asset utilization, customer satisfaction, and sustainability. For the sake of better illustration, matrix and mind map are utilized to present the evolution of financial data. For the sake of data processing, Excel is utilized to analysis and visualize the results. According to the model evaluation, the most important parameter is cost because the procurement and R&D costs can be significantly reduced. Inventory as working capital is also vital for ROBAM due to the problem of high inventory fluctuations. Based on the analysis, suggestions and strategies are proposed to improve its supply chain management and remain competitiveness correspondingly. These results shed light for SCM improvements of similar types of corporations.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Communication on the Trust Between Supply Chain Enterprises Based on Structural Equation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on E-Commerce and E-Management (ICECEM)
abstract: The revolution of information technology such as blockchain and the Internet of Things has significantly changed the way of communication and trust between supply chain enterprises. However, few studies have focused on this phenomenon. This study aims to examine the effect of communication on trust between supply chain enterprises in the context of emerging information technologies. Based on the literatures, the assumption is proposed by constructing the inter-enterprises trust model with the samples of 196 manufacturing enterprises in China. SPSS 22.0 and AMOS 22.0 are used for empirical analysis. Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) is adopted to analyze the total reality and validity for measurements. Structural equation model (SEM) is applied to analyze the relationship among the latent variables and construct the hypothesis testing. The results show that communication has a positive effect on trust among supply chain enterprises. Especially, instrumental communication rooted in information technology is positively related to information sharing. What's more, information sharing plays a partial mediating role between instrumental communication and trust among supply chain enterprises. The findings enhance our understanding of the relationships among communication and trust between supply chain in information intelligence age, thereby guiding enterprises to implement informatization strategy in supply chain management.
